mean_regressor.description: Predicts constant training target mean. Minimizes squared loss among constant predictors.

median_regressor.description: Predicts constant training target median. Minimizes L1 absolute loss among constant predictors.

pure_physics_schottky_baseline.description: Calculates log10(Rc) directly from ideal Schottky-Mott barrier (Phi_M - 4.2 eV) assuming classic thermionic transport without Fermi pinning.
